dimension_scores.evidence: p5 prompt now forces full-time multiband, wide 5-7 slot ranges, T2C3 few-shot, build_v5 failure warning; proven multiband seeds are whitelisted/tested.
dimension_scores.missing: coverage ledger, mined data-context injection, and mutator-based local seed expansion are incomplete.
dimension_scores.improvement: Add coverage_ledger plus mine_generation_context, then generate seeds by uncovered time x cap x signal cells, not by fixed round-robin principles.

dimension_scores.evidence: P0b refine gate accepts known-good THETA and refuses no-go candidate; full train/OOS escalation blocks false positives such as iter7.
dimension_scores.missing: near-miss preservation, gate-distance learning signal, PBO/CSCV/DSR integration, and structured feedback summaries remain incomplete.
dimension_scores.improvement: Keep P0 gate first, then add gate_distance/reason fields and use only gate-passing feedback in later generation.

dimension_scores.evidence: gen_template_hypothesis accepts --feedback-file; stateful n=8 made 3/8 smoke-pass vs random 0/8.
dimension_scores.missing: OOS survivor is still 0; feedback can preserve smoke-pass patterns that overfit full train; feedback text has flattening/drift risk.
dimension_scores.improvement: Feedback must penalize smoke-pass/train-fail patterns, preserve only full-train/OOS survivors, and show valid-attempt/rate/C3 in summaries.

dimension_scores.evidence: T2C3 proves time x cap branch value; new prompt considers tick 09:00-09:30 and min 09:00-15:00 bands.
dimension_scores.missing: latest generated tick_new/tick_anchor candidates did not survive OOS; data beyond current tick window is not expanded.
dimension_scores.improvement: Use T2C3 as anchor branch, require second branch to pass P0/P1, and only then expand 09:30+ or broader universe data.

dimension_scores.evidence: min template/data path exists, but min_session default and min_new loops are negative; min data has only about 11 months.
dimension_scores.missing: min-specific primitive map, OOS-equivalent split, and variable-safe min context are still weak.
dimension_scores.improvement: Do not promote min full-day generation until primitive maps find at least one robust time-band corner across train/split validation.

dimension_scores.evidence: 14-28 no-go, multiband overnight PROMISING 0, A/B n=8 OOS promising 0.
dimension_scores.missing: No new non-correlated alpha beyond THETA/T2C3 has survived train/OOS/WF.
dimension_scores.improvement: Stop random broad loops; run P0/P1 A/B to decide if process can beat random, otherwise shift to data expansion and D-scale operation.

dimension_scores.evidence: record/dashboard observability audit scores record management 9.0/10 and observability 8.5/10.
dimension_scores.missing: stateful progress labels, rate panels, and document path drift remain.
dimension_scores.improvement: Normalize summary schema and add progress/rate/C3 fields before more overnight runs.

dimension_scores.evidence: research artifacts are detailed, but git status contains many untracked templates, scripts, tests, and evidence files.
dimension_scores.missing: curation, staging plan, and separation of durable docs from disposable run artifacts.
dimension_scores.improvement: Create a commit/ignore/archive decision table before implementation continues.

recommended_order: P0: keep reject/backtest refine gate first; do not enable in-sample feedback before this gate.
P1: finish A/B comparison with explicit OOS-promising metric and rate/C3 summary.
P2: fix stateful feedback so smoke-pass/train-fail patterns are avoid signals, not preferred signals.
P3: add data-driven seed context and coverage ledger for time x cap x signal cells.
P4: add grid/coarse-to-fine and mutator only after P1 shows stateful edge.
P5: continue D-scale paper operation for THETA/T2C3 while new-alpha discovery remains OOS-zero.
